scenes.hook: JavaScript Data Types. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: JavaScript values have different types with different behavior. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Text is a string, a numeric value is a number, and true is a boolean.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: The type of operator can help inspect the type of a value. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: A number inside quotation marks is a string, which changes some operations.
scenes.try: Create a string, a number, and a boolean. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
